source.title: Ariel Ann - Photos - IMDb
source.description:
Ariel Ann Headshot

Ariel Ann, the Taiwanese actress born on March 5, 1985, is captured in a professional portrait that emphasizes her serene presence. Her long dark hair flows freely around her shoulders as she gazes thoughtfully to the side, creating an introspective atmosphere.

Wearing a sleeveless denim top against a neutral backdrop, the soft lighting accentuates her smooth complexion and delicate features. Known for her roles in Game (2016), Ba Ji Teenagers (2015), and Di Renjie zhi lunhui tu (2018), this image is sourced from her IMDb media index page showcasing her portfolio of photos.

source.title: 為戲改掉茹素、剪50公分長髮！《愛．殺》陽靚北影首封后 | 娛樂 | Newtalk新聞
source.description:
陽靚首封后致詞瞬間

第23屆台北電影節頒獎典禮於10月9日在台北舉行，最佳女主角獎由《愛．殺》中的陽靚首度奪得。她為了詮釋同志更生人的角色，不僅剪掉50公分長髮，還改掉茹素習慣，展現強烈的表演張力。

頒獎典禮由去年影后王淨與李烈共同主持。陽靚上台後深情致詞，將獎項獻給家人、朋友與另一半，並以「你永遠都不知道此刻做的選擇會帶你去哪」鼓勵大家勇敢追夢。現場氣氛莊重而溫馨，成為當晚最動人的時刻。
